---
title: "August Temperature Analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

temp_data <- read_csv("willamette_temp.csv")

```

## August Data

```{r}

august_data <- subset(temp_data, month == "Aug")

```

## GLM Trend Analysis

```{r}

august_model <- glm(
  temp_C ~ year * site_no,
  data = august_data
)

summary(august_model)

```

## Visualization

```{r}

ggplot(august_data,
       aes(x = year,
           y = temp_C,
           color = site_no)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +

  labs(
    title = "August Stream Temperature Trends",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Temperature (°C)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal()

```
